_comment: The only place the Windows and Mac how-to video IDs live. Used by the setup guide (click-to-load player + VideoObject JSON-LD), the 'watch the video' hint links and the help page. TR pages use tr, every other language uses en. Covers are local copies of the YouTube thumbnails (no third-party request before a click).

en.name: How to use your phone's internet on a Windows PC | Tether Link Utility
en.description: One setup file, a few clicks, and your Windows PC uses your Android phone's connection. Every app works.

tr.description: Tek kurulum dosyası, birkaç tıklama: Windows bilgisayarın Android telefonunun bağlantısını kullanır. Bütün uygulamalar çalışır.

en.name: How to use your phone's internet on your Mac | Tether Link Utility
en.description: Share your Android phone's connection with your Mac in a few steps. Every app works, not just the browser.
